description: Recommend literacy-growth chart picks for a dataset given an AudienceProfile. Returns charts the data supports but the audience is unfamiliar with (familiarity ≤ 3, or ≤ 4 at exposureLevel 2), each paired with the familiar chart it could substitute for and a rationale. Use when the consumer wants to gently expose users to less familiar but more analytically appropriate visualizations.

audience.description: Audience profile — familiarity, targets, exposure level, reception modality.

fieldRoles.description: Per-field semantic or exact encoding-role hints used before chart ranking.

identifiers.description: Fields that identify records and must not be used as visual encodings or measures.

name: suggestStretchCharts
